== How this catalog was built ==

* The site's Tourny Reports page (articles.html) was checked in every Internet Archive capture from 1 June 2000 to 23 October 2009. The 1 June 2000 capture links no reports; every capture from 14 October 2000 on links the same nine. The site's reports.html (captured 23 May 2000) lists the same nine.
* The report pages themselves were never captured on the GeoCities host. Each article quotes the OoCities mirror, captured on 2 February 2019, and the mirror copies are still live.
* Alcalde's 1999 Corellia Regional page (regional.html) is not on the Tourny Reports page but is linked from the site's navigation, and it is a full report with standings, so it has an article too. It was captured on the GeoCities host on 18 June 2000; it is a copy of Decipher's NewsFlash of 27 September 1999.
* The site's card reviews are not tournament reports and are left out.
* Young Jedi events named in the DecipherCon reports are not recorded.
* In Alcalde's DecipherCon report a personal email address under the byline is removed and marked in place. The other report pages hid their authors' addresses inside HTML tags, so they did not show on the page and are not reproduced.
* The informal Squadron Members' sealed night on 13 November 1999 has its own page, [[DecipherCon 1999 Squadron Members Sealed Deck]], because two reports describe it. No results were posted.

— Comlink Cursor, 27 October 2026
